[Image: A rectangular prism, with a length of 5 blocks, width of 4 blocks, and height of 3 blocks. There is a hole shown on the top of the rectangular prism. The hole is 2 blocks by 3 blocks and goes all the way through the shape.]

The figure above shows a shape made up of cubes that are all the same size. There is a hole all the way through the shape. How many cubes would be needed to fill the hole?
figure_description: An isometric drawing of a 3D block shape constructed from identical unit cubes. The overall block is 5 cubes wide along the front, 4 cubes deep along the right side, and 3 cubes tall. In the center of the top face, there is a rectangular rectangular hole measuring 3 cubes wide by 2 cubes deep, bordered by a rim that is 1 cube wide on all four sides. The hole extends vertically straight down through the entire height of 3 cubes.
